snapshots.name: Default Entry State
snapshots.purpose: Both edition cards in baseline state. Couple card interactive at baseline weight; friend card visibly disabled and lower opacity (0.72). Establishes the initial information hierarchy and affordance clarity.

snapshots.name: Couple Edition Focused
snapshots.purpose: Couple card receives visual emphasis (scale 1.02, translateY -2px) signaling readiness to navigate. Friend card remains grayed and disabled. Demonstrates focus/selection affordance.

snapshots.name: Friend Edition Focused
snapshots.purpose: Friend card receives opacity boost (0.88) even though it remains disabled. Shows that visual focus is independent of interactivity. Couple card returns to baseline state.
